G1_rank_zero_exactness.note: Tolerance is PER-METRIC split-half variability tol_m = 2*sd(metric(half1)-metric(half2)) over 200 random halvings, NOT a global 0.05.

G3_gate1_band50_correction.derivation: 14 identical rank-1 projectors contribute lambda_max = 14; the remaining 14 are independent and contribute O(1). Hence 14/28 = 0.500.
G3_gate1_band50_correction.verdict: GATE 1 REPRODUCES with one corrected expectation. The 0.105 figure is algebraically impossible under the stated formula and is not quoted anywhere in this artifact. The windowing advantage on a 50%-band edit is REAL but SMALLER than the hypothesis claimed.
G3_gate1_band50_correction.does_not_affect: The independent real-weight finding (honest BSA 0.565 vs a 0.35 separator, FPR 1.0) is measured, not simulated, and stands.

G4_key_shape_sanity.note: A merged LoRA restores EXACTLY the base key set and shapes, so the key/shape screen is structurally blind to it. When F3/F4 come back undetectable that CONFIRMS the already-published claim (AMS arXiv 2608.05578: behavioural fine-tuning is undetectable by activation-only probing) and is not our discovery.

G5_botgap_bf16.note: Use a bf16-realistic separator (~0.01), never an exact zero.

_summary.policy: A failed gate DEGRADES the affected metric class (marked ASSUMPTION_FAILED in every downstream row); it never aborts the run.

G6_gram_update_identities.what: ROSI and carrier edits are applied as EXACT O(d^2) updates of the cached float64 Gram; this gate checks both identities and the dsyrk Gram against dense recomputation on a random 40x90 matrix
